note: Rewritten from the species description in Scheffrahn (2018), originally in English; in Table 1 the male 'maximum pronotum width' is printed as 1.97—20.9, an obvious OCR corruption (misplaced decimal point), reproduced as printed because the text gives no other value; the N. chilensis comparison data in Tables 1 and 2 belong to another species and are not recorded; figure numbers, type material and biological notes are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate has larger compound eyes and ocelli than N. chilensis and possesses an arolium, which the latter lacks. In the soldier the basal process of the mandible is far less prominent than in N. chilensis, the marginal tooth curves more gently and the apical tooth is less strongly curved; N. chilensis has more strongly constricted anterolateral corners and projecting genal angles, whereas in the new species the genal angles do not project in ventral view. The soldier pronotum is bow-tie shaped, crescent-shaped in N. chilensis; the soldier eye spots are translucent in the new species but almost always pigmented in N. chilensis. Compared with N. castaneus, the mandibles of both the new species and N. chilensis are narrower and more elongate, with a less rounded basal process.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum orange brown. Compound eyes nearly circular; ocelli yellow orange, large, roundly oval, almost touching the eye margin. Vertex and frons slightly concave, without rugae; with several dozen setae about 0.25 mm long and variously directed. Pronotum wider than the head capsule; anterior margin evenly concave, very weakly notched. Pronotum covered with shorter setae and many long setae about 0.3 mm long, especially on the lateral margins. Antenna 17—22 segmented, relative lengths of the basal segments 1>2=3>4. Anterior margin of the forewing scale convex, with a row of 12—15 setae. Forewing subcosta merging with the costa at about one-fifth of the wing length from the wing suture; radius merging with the costa at two-fifths of the wing length; radial sector with about 7 anterior branches. Media sclerotized, close to and parallel with the radial sector. Arolium present. Measurements (mm; females 3 nests, 8 specimens, males 5 nests, 10 specimens; mean, range): head width (excluding compound eyes) female 1.7 (1.60—1.90)/male 1.69 (1.66—1.72); head width (including compound eyes) female 1.84 (1.76—1.96)/male 1.85 (1.78—1.94); maximum pronotum width female 2.07 (1.98—2.13)/male 2.02 (1.97—20.9, an obvious OCR corruption in the original, reproduced as printed); maximum compound eye diameter female 0.56 (0.50—0.60)/male 0.57 (0.50—0.61); body length female 8.56 (7.14—13.17)/male 8.47 (6.80—9.40); right forewing length female 14.67 (14.00—16.35)/male 15.41 (13.00—16.19); body length with wings female 17.43 (16.51—17.94)/male 17.59 (16.30—18.73); number of antennal segments female 18.9 (17—21)/male 19.75 (17—22).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule orange brown in dorsal and lateral view, yellow orange ventrally; pronotum yellow orange. Eye spots yellow, small, narrowly oval. Head and pronotum with short and medium-length (0.15—0.25 mm) setae, denser and longer on the frontal lobes. Lateral margins of the head capsule nearly parallel, slightly convergent anteriorly; genal angles not projecting in ventral view. Frons sloping from the vertex in an arc of about 45°; from the width of the postclypeus to the anterior vertex concave and finely rugose. Y-shaped suture distinct and narrow. Pronotum 2.5 times as wide as long, posterior margin slightly concave, posterolateral corners rounded at 90°. Antenna 14—16 segmented, relative lengths of the basal segments 1>2<3>4. Mandibular basal process shallow, situated more than 4/5 of the total length from the apex; mandible evenly curved through about 80° along the apical third. Measurements (10 specimens, mm; mean, range): head length to lateral mandible base 3.46 (2.66—3.92); maximum head width 2.44 (2.25—2.66); maximum head height including postmentum 2.04 (1.72—2.30); pronotum length 1.38 (1.20—1.69); pronotum width 2.60 (2.38—3.06); number of antennal segments 15 (14—16); third antennal segment length 0.17 (0.14—0.19).
